name: Houkai Jokyoku
source:
Main character gets mistaken for a pervert on the train one day, but that incident helps him to get acquainted with Miyuki who goes to the same university. They start dating, but Miyuki has phobia of physical relations due to past trauma. However after one seminar titled "Respect for self" she starts to behave differently...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天，男主角在电车上被误认成色狼，却因此结识了同校大学生槙村深雪。两人开始交往，但深雪因过去的创伤而恐惧身体接触。然而，在参加一场题为「尊重自我」的研讨会后，她的行为开始发生变化……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
